test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 19 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two figures given on the left side of (::) are related with some logic/rule/relation. Select the missing figure on the right side of (::) from the given alternatives based on the same logic/rule/relation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb4320d09c6da136a1780ab5bd388113f3350c1344aa9afe3671733b6a7a12ac.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: In the first image, the pattern relates the **number of sides of the shape** to the **number of lines crossing its boundary**. Options 1, 2, and 3 follow the rule (n sides = n lines), while Option 4 does not (triangle with 4 lines).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a94dffa413fc0654aa5d4fe9e72ec46037caba053339d76e5c894bf56a151e37.png] 

Now, checking the Options:

Option 1: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e465cd5305cc061c3d5010c107869e92815f659675b79201a74036e4f853480f.png] 

4-sided arrow-head with 4 lines – Follows the rule

Option 2: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e465cd5305cc061c3d5010c107869e92815f659675b79201a74036e4f853480f.png] 

5-sided pentagon with 5 lines – Follows the rule

Option 3: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94b2461b163657138c1025761050a18452825abf89815ec4d2a349494485c030.png] 

4-sided rectangle with 4 lines – Follows the rule

Option 4: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c1fe322b35e8ecca0d200e639bf23d79c30cd841319dea07462c9e6a96c2cda.png] 

3-sided triangle with 4 lines – Breaks the rule → Odd one out

Hence, **Option 4** is the odd figure pair.
